simplicity.evidence: Code is mostly minimal and reuses Eloquent/factories, but `nextCode()` both reads the high-water mark and plucks/scans every code in the queue on each issuance (app/Models/Ticket.php:105-113), and the mutable-column allow-list is duplicated in app/Models/Ticket.php:34-39 and app/Models/Builders/TicketBuilder.php:15-20.

readability.evidence: Names are clear and methods are focused, with useful PHPDoc (app/Models/Ticket.php:95-102, 131-136; app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:16-21). The duplicated immutable-field constant (Ticket.php:34, TicketBuilder.php:15) and the subtle `setRawAttributes(...)`/save-`$this` refresh at Ticket.php:151-155 make write-once logic harder to follow than it needs to be.

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the task: migrations, models, enums, exception, action, factories, feature tests, and the required docs/CHANGELOG updates (task.md:9-11, conventions.md:92-103). The architecture TODO replacement (docs/architecture.md:122-125) just links the new test; no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: Adds a `last_ticket_number` high-water column (also cast at app/Models/Queue.php:26) that is not part of the queue fields defined in task.md:15-16; it is documented and used for non-reuse, but it expands the agreed schema.

`Ticket::call()` authorizes with an ad-hoc `$user->membershipFor($queue->entity_id)` check instead of a policy/gate, contrary to conventions.md:40-41 ("Authorization always goes through policies/gates").
The required retry on a unique `(queue_id, code)` collision is implemented but no test exercises that path; tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php only covers the non-collision issuance paths.

`nextCode()` reads the per-queue high-water mark and then also plucks and scans every ticket code for the queue on each issuance, duplicating the max calculation and adding O(n) work that the high-water mark already covers.

The list of mutable ticket columns is duplicated between `Ticket::MUTABLE_COLUMNS` (app/Models/Ticket.php:34) and `TicketBuilder::$mutableColumns`; a single shared constant would prevent the two allow-lists from drifting.

Models declare fillable through the `#[Fillable]` attribute rather than a `$fillable` property; `composer.json` is not in the diff, so support for `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable` and consistency with sibling models cannot be verified.

review.summary: This change implements the queue/ticket persistence, models, enums, factories, the IssueTicket action and the single-call guard, and updates the domain, schema, architecture and changelog docs with a broad Pest suite. The domain behavior and most edge cases (code sequencing, non-reuse, malformed codes, stale/inactive queues, write-once, single call, non-member denial) look correct; the main nits are the extra `last_ticket_number` column, authorization done inline instead of via a policy, duplicated mutable-column lists and a missing collision-retry test.
